text:
anya: Quick heads-up — Q3 'Labs' experiment request landed from two pilot customers (AcmeHealth, Orchid Payments). They want a bundle: dashboard templates, trace hook snippets, and a cost breakdown view.

mike: Can we scope a minimal deliverable that lets them run benchmarks without full rollout? maybe a gated flag + example dashboards.

rashid: Minimal = 3 dashboards (latency heatmap, per-model cost, error waterfall) + one tracing hook (span tagging for customer-id). Should include sampling guidance.

sam: Agree. Also need acceptance criteria. Propose:
- dashboard rendering < 800ms for 95th pct on seeded data
- trace hook captures tags in < 1ms overhead
- cost view matches billing within 3% on test load

anya: That looks right. Customers also asked for a sample eval harness: steady ramp 100 -> 2k reqs/min for 30m and a script to reproduce.

mike: For the trace hook, can we provide a code snippet? e.g.:
```python
# attach customer tag to root span
span.set_attribute("customer.id", customer_id)
span.set_attribute("model.variant", model_variant)
```

rashid: Nice. On sampling: recommend adaptive sampling with head-based retention for errors. Rules: retain 100% of error traces, 5% of success traces, and keep 1k unique prefixes cached for prefix-KV usage.

sam: Cost breakdown UX note: show token-based cost delta if quantized vs float16; show per-route cost trend over last 24h and last 7d. Also a toggle to view committed vs burst.

anya: Operational asks: rollout path = labs flag -> canary customers (AcmeHealth only) -> broaden to Orchid Payments -> GA. Timeline? 6 weeks to labs, 3 weeks for canary, 2 weeks for post-canary fixes.

mike: Risks: dashboard load on big tenants could spike metrics ingestion. Mitigations: pre-aggregate for dashboard queries and limit retention on trial tenants.

rashid: Data retention policy for labs: 7d raw traces, 30d pre-aggregates. For enterprise (post-GA) default to 30d raw. Need legal signoff for AcmeHealth (PHI?).

sam: Launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- Performance gates met (dashboard <800ms, trace hook <1ms)
- Billing parity within 3% on synthetic load
- Customer-run benchmark scripts pass (2 customers)
- Documentation + quickstart (1 page) created
- Dev/sre runbook for oncall + fallback to lightweight metrics view

anya: Customer asks also: exportable CSV of cost breakdown and ability to tag routes by product-team. Add to scope?

mike: Add as stretch. Important but not required for initial lab.

rashid: Quick implementation notes for eng-runtime: need a tight path for span attribute propagation into our metrics pipeline. I'll pair with infra to prototype a 2-stage extractor.

observability-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for feature/labs-console at 1766664800 — estimated 30m window.

anya: Thanks — next steps: rashid & mike to draft minimal schema + dashboard templates by EOD Wed; sam to sketch acceptance playbook; I'll coordinate legal for AcmeHealth. I'll open a doc and tag this thread. :white_check_mark:

mike: ack, will PR templates.

rashid: ack, prototyping span extractor now.

sam: will write acceptance checklist and sample scripts.

anya: closing note: keep the labs flag isolated to the console team until canary. No GA marketing messaging until after post-canary signoff.
